```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = FALSE, echo = FALSE)
```

```{r lib_load}
library(tidyverse)   # data wrangling & ggplot2
library(janitor)     # functions for examining and cleaning dirty data
library(kableExtra)  # simple table generator
library(here)        # Find files within a project
library(olsrr)       # package for p-value backward elimination
library(broom)       # summarizes key information about models
library(rlang)       # functions for Base Types and Core R and 'Tidyverse' Features
library(car)         # VIF, influence measures helpers
library(scales)      # provides the internal scaling infrastructure used by ggplot
library(fastDummies) # Fast Creation of Dummy (Binary) Columns & Rows from Categorical Variables
```

```{r fun, results='hide'}
codf    <- readRDS(file = here("rmds/modfunctions", "codfunctions.rds"))
codform <- readRDS(file = here("rmds", "codformulas.rds"))

codf_env <- list2env(codf, parent = globalenv())
for (nm in names(codf)) {environment(codf[[nm]]) <- codf_env}
list2env(codf, envir = codf_env)
source(here("rmds/cod2325/districtruns/d2325f", "spss_cod_district-7_23-25f.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
```

```{r data_import}
load(file = here("data/rdata", "cod_2022-2025geo_23July.RData"))
load(file = here("data/rdata", "cod_2022-2025_July23.RData"))

ecfs_col <- character(0)
if (isTRUE(make_ecf_dummies)) {
  if (!has_fastd) stop("make_ecf_dummies=TRUE requires fastDummies package.")
  if (!("ecf" %in% names(df25))) stop("ecf column not found after rename; cannot dummy.")
  
  df25 <- fastDummies::dummy_cols(
    df25, select_columns = "ecf", remove_first_dummy = remove_first_dummy,
    remove_selected_columns = !keep_ecf_original
  )
  sales_df <- fastDummies::dummy_cols(
    sales_df, select_columns = "ecf", remove_first_dummy = remove_first_dummy,
    remove_selected_columns = !keep_ecf_original
  )
  ecfs_col <- grep("^ecf_", names(df26), value = TRUE)
}
```

---

## Model I

```{r mod1}
mod_time <- codf$backward_p(formula = codform$formula_time_g1, data = sales_df, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)
sales_df <- codf$make_time_adjusted_df(sales_df, codform$formula_time_g1)

codf$plot_standard_residual_hist(mod_time, sales_df, ptitle = "Histogram\nDependent Variable: LN_SPPSF + Geo")

mod_time2 <- codf$backward_p(formula = codform$formula_time, data = df25, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)
df25 <- codf$make_time_adjusted_df(df25, codform$formula_time)
```

```{r mod1a, results='asis'}
codf$model_metrics_A(mod_time, "Citywide LN\\_SPPSF model fit statistics + Geo")
codf$coef_table(mod_time, "Citywide LN\\_SPPSF model coefficients (95% CI) + Geo")
```

```{r mod1b}
mf <- model.frame(mod_time)
row_idx <- as.integer(rownames(mf))
aug_sppsf <- broom::augment(mod_time, data = sales_df[row_idx, ]) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pred_sppsf = exp(.fitted), std_resid  = .std.resid)
codf$plot_residuals_vs_months(aug_sppsf, ptitle = "Residuals for LN_SPPSF Model + Geo")
```

```{r mod1c}
codf$plot_predicted_sppsf_vs_months(aug_sppsf, ptitle = "Months vs Predicted SPPSF - LN_SPPSF Model + Geo")
```

```{r mod1d}
codf$plot_price_index_vs_months(sales_df)
```

```{r mod1e}
codf$plot_taf_vs_months(sales_df)
```

## Model II

```{r mod2}
mod_ln_price_no_ecf <- codf$backward_p(codform$formula_ln_price_no_ecf_g1,
                                  data = sales_df, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)

codf$plot_standard_residual_hist(mod_ln_price_no_ecf, sales_df,
                                 ptitle = "Histogram\nDependent Variable: LN_PRICE (No ECFs) + Geo")

mod_ln_price_no_ecf2 <- codf$backward_p(codform$formula_ln_price_no_ecf,
                                  data = df25, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)
```

```{r mod2a, results='asis'}
codf$model_metrics_A(mod_ln_price_no_ecf, "Citywide LN\\_PRICE (No ECFs) model fit statistics + Geo")
codf$coef_table(mod_ln_price_no_ecf, "Citywide LN\\_PRICE (No ECFs) model coefficients (95% CI) + Geo")

codf$model_metrics_A(mod_ln_price_no_ecf2, "Citywide LN\\_PRICE (No ECFs) model fit statistics")
codf$coef_table(mod_ln_price_no_ecf2, "Citywide LN\\_PRICE (No ECFs) model coefficients (95% CI)")
```

```{r mod2b}
mf <- model.frame(mod_ln_price_no_ecf)
row_idx <- as.integer(rownames(mf))
aug_sppsf <- broom::augment(mod_ln_price_no_ecf, data = sales_df[row_idx, ]) |>

codf$plot_residuals_vs_months(aug_sppsf, ptitle = "Residuals for LN_PRICE (No ECFs) Model + Geo")
```

```{r mod2c}
codf$plot_leverage_histogram(model = mod_ln_price_no_ecf, df = sales_df, subtitle = "Dependent Variable: LN\\_PRICE + Geo")
```



## Model III

```{r mod3}
baserhs_g1 <- c(
  "ln_landratio", "ln_base_bldgsize_ratio", "arterial",
  "single_family1story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest", "two_plus_baths", "powder_room",
  "good", "fair", "poor", "very_poor_unsound", "qabove_avg", "qbelow_avg",
  "yb_pre_1929", "yb_1946_to_1960", "yb_post_1961", "crawl", "slab",
  "ln_garagespaces", "fireplace", "hot_water", "elec_baseboard", "wall", "central_air",
  ecfs_col,  # <-- splices *all* secf_ dummy columns in correctly
  "months_1to9", "months_10to16", "months_17to24", "near_downtown_1mi", "near_downtown_5mi"
)

formula_base_g1 <- reformulate(baserhs_g1, response = "ln_price")

mod_base <- codf$backward_p(formula_base_g1, data = sales_df, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)

resbase  <- codf$assess_ln_price_model(sales_df, mod_base)

df       <- resbase$data
df_in    <- resbase$data_inliers
resbase$rrmetrics_kable
```

### Filtered Input

```{r mod3i}
mod_base_inliers <- codf$backward_p(formula_base_g1, data = df_in,
                                    p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)

resbasei <- codf$refit_inlier_ln_price(
  df = df, df_in = df_in, formula_base = formula_base_g1, mod_base = mod_base
)

df_in            <- resbasei$data_inliers
dfa              <- resbasei$join_data
df_in1           <- resbasei$extract_data
```

```{r mod3igeonot}
mod_base_inliers2 <- codf$backward_p(formula_base, data = df_in2,
                                    p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)

resbasei2 <- codf$refit_inlier_ln_price(
  df = df2, df_in = df_in2, formula_base = formula_base, mod_base = mod_base2
)

df_in2            <- resbasei2$data_inliers
dfa2              <- resbasei2$join_data
df_in12           <- resbasei2$extract_data
```

## Model IV

```{r mod4}
tasprhs_g1 <- c(
  "ln_landratio", "ln_base_bldgsize_ratio", "arterial",
  "single_family1story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest", "two_plus_baths", "powder_room",
  "good", "fair", "poor", "very_poor_unsound", "qabove_avg", "qbelow_avg",
  "yb_pre_1929", "yb_1946_to_1960", "yb_post_1961", "crawl", "slab",
  "ln_garagespaces", "fireplace", "hot_water", "elec_baseboard", "wall", "central_air",
  ecfs_col, "near_downtown_1mi", "near_downtown_5mi"
)

formula_ln_tasp_g1 <- reformulate(tasprhs_g1, response = "ln_tasp_re")

mod_tasp1 <- codf$backward_p(formula_ln_tasp_g1, data = dfa, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)

dfa <- dfa %>%
  mutate(
    pre_3 = predict(mod_tasp1, newdata = dfa), esp3  = exp(pre_3), ratio3 = esp3 / tasp_re
  )

rrmetrics <- codf$ratio_metrics(dfa, esp3, saleprice)

knitr::kable(
  rrmetrics,  format   = "latex",  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption  = "Citywide LN\\_TASP Model I Assessing Coefficients + Geo" 
) %>%  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "striped"), font_size = 8)


altrhs_g1 <- c(
  "ln_landratio", "lnsbldsfint", "arterial",
  "single_family1story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest", "two_plus_baths", "powder_room",
  "good", "fair", "poor", "very_poor_unsound", "qabove_avg", "qbelow_avg",
  "yb_pre_1929", "yb_1946_to_1960", "yb_post_1961", "crawl", "slab", "garage", "fireplace",
  "hot_water", "elec_baseboard", "wall", "central_air", ecfs_col, "near_downtown_1mi", "near_downtown_5mi"
)

formula_alt_g1 <- reformulate(altrhs_g1, response = "ln_tasp_re")

mod_tasp2 <- codf$backward_p(formula_alt_g1, data = dfa, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)

dfa <- dfa %>%
  mutate(
    pre_4 = predict(mod_tasp2, newdata = dfa), esp4 = exp(pre_4), ratio4 = esp4 / tasp_re
  )

rrmetrics <- codf$ratio_metrics(dfa, esp4, saleprice)

knitr::kable(
  rrmetrics,  format   = "latex",  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption  = "Citywide LN\\_TASP Model II Assessing Coefficients + Geo" 
) %>%  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "striped"), font_size = 8)
```

```{r modsss, eval=FALSE}
d4_mod_time_23_25 <- mod_time
d4_mod_ln_price_no_ecf_23_25 <- mod_ln_price_no_ecf
d4_mod_base_23_25 <- mod_base
d4_mod_base_inliers_23_25 <- mod_base_inliers
d4_mod_tasp1_23_25 <- mod_tasp1
d4_mod_tasp2_23_25 <- mod_tasp2

codf$save_model_bundle(
  model_names = c("d4_mod_time_23_25", "d4_mod_ln_price_no_ecf_23_25", "d4_mod_base_23_25",
                  "d4_mod_base_inliers_23_25", "d4_mod_tasp1_23_25", "d4_mod_tasp2_23_25"),
  bundle_path = here("models/codmods/districtmods", "cod_district-4_23-25_31Mar.rds"),
  manifest_csv_path = here("models/codmods/districtmods", "cod_district-4_23-25_31Mar_manifest.csv")
)
```

